biggest_catch: Requires parking $2,500 for 90 days: you must complete at least $2,500 in direct deposits within 60 days AND maintain a minimum balance of $2,500 for 90 days. Only residents of OR, WA, CA, and ID. Not available if your accounts were closed within the last 2 years.
catches: Open any new Banner Bank personal checking account online at bannerbank.com or at a Banner Bank branch and use promotional code 2026EM at account opening.
Complete at least $2,500 of direct deposits into that account within 60 days of account opening.
Maintain a minimum balance of $2,500 for 90 days.
Offer available to residents of OR, WA, CA, and ID only.
Not available to those whose accounts have been closed within the last 2 years; to qualify for the checking offer you must not already have a personal checking account.
Only one new account opening-related bonus every 2 years on a personal checking account (and one every 2 years on a personal savings or money market account).
Offer subject to change without notice and may not be combined with any other offer.

steps: Open any new Banner Bank personal checking account online at bannerbank.com or at a Banner Bank branch, entering promotional code 2026EM at account opening.
Complete at least $2,500 of direct deposits into that account within 60 days of account opening.
Maintain a minimum balance of $2,500 for 90 days.
Keep the account open and in good standing; bonus is credited once all requirements are met.
